1999.notes: Employee occupational privilege tax $2.00 per month when the employee earns $250.00 or more in a calendar month (employers pay a matching $2.00); the brochure says the tax has existed since January 1, 1980 (city tax brochure, Wayback capture of April 21, 1999). Amounts before 1999 are not documented.
